error.invalid_access_key: Zeekr rejected the HMAC access key. Check that the extracted API keys match your account region (for Europe, extract with --region EU).
error.signature_failed: Zeekr rejected the API signature. Check the HMAC keys and prod secret for the selected region. This does not necessarily mean your account password is wrong.
error.account_in_use: Zeekr reports that this account is logged in elsewhere. Check for another app or integration session using this account, then retry.
error.region_lookup_failed: Zeekr could not resolve the API region. Check the country code and region-specific HMAC keys. This error can also occur when the region lookup request is rejected; it does not prove that your country is unsupported.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Zeekr. Check network connectivity and retry.
error.timeout: The request to Zeekr timed out. Please retry later.
error.setup_failed: Zeekr login or setup failed. Check your account details, country and API keys. See the integration log for the failure category.
